name: CONNSKILL Growth Services
description: Search research for AI agents: Local Market Check packages, domain ranking snapshots and keyword demand data. Also SMS verification, receive-only inboxes, social marketing and EU-hosted LLMs. Paid per call in USDC on Base. No account, no API key, no minimum.

policy.auth: No account or API key. Manual first purchases and private redelivery require a free Sign-In-With-X wallet proof from POST /v1/payments/challenge.
policy.payment: x402 v2, USDC on Base (eip155:8453), pay-per-call to 0x43B85AE58f0A2505c710Bc715d6f3EB16b1f63dE
policy.idempotency: A fresh wallet proof bound to the exact original request and payment references can retrieve its retained private result without another payment.
policy.redelivery: Private redelivery only reads a retained result. A missing result or uncertain purchase remains held for wallet support; it never starts another provider order.
policy.refund: On-chain settlement is technically final. This does not exclude statutory claims. Invalid input is rejected before settlement; failed delivery must be resolved through the delivery policy and support.
policy.unclearState: If a purchase times out and we cannot tell whether the provider charged us, you get HTTP 504 with stateUnclear — so you never blindly re-order.
policy.timeouts: No uptime SLA. Every outbound call has a timeout (provider 20s, DataForSEO 45s, purchase 60s); the gateway hard-caps at 90s and returns 504 rather than hanging.
policy.rateLimit: Paid service calls have no per-caller rate limit. Wallet challenges have bounded capacity and can return 429. Request size limits apply. We never log your IP; only technical metadata such as User-Agent and Referer.
